serviceParameters.description: Process as fast as possible; pacing is driven by the TTS producer
Small output buffer for low-latency streaming
Flush output at least every 100 milliseconds

pcm_s16_8k.specs: rawaudioparse format=pcm pcm-format=s16le sample-rate=8000 num-channels=1 ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! queue ! c.

pcm_s16_16k.specs: rawaudioparse format=pcm pcm-format=s16le sample-rate=16000 num-channels=1 ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! queue ! c.

pcm_s16_24k.specs: rawaudioparse format=pcm pcm-format=s16le sample-rate=24000 num-channels=1 ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! queue ! c.

pcm_s16_48k.specs: rawaudioparse format=pcm pcm-format=s16le sample-rate=48000 num-channels=1 ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! queue ! c.

pcm_f32_16k.specs: rawaudioparse format=pcm pcm-format=f32le sample-rate=16000 num-channels=1 ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! queue ! c.

pcm_f32_24k.specs: rawaudioparse format=pcm pcm-format=f32le sample-rate=24000 num-channels=1 ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! queue ! c.

pcm_f32_48k.specs: rawaudioparse format=pcm pcm-format=f32le sample-rate=48000 num-channels=1 ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! queue ! c.

mp3-16khz.specs: concat name=c ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! audio/x-raw,format=S16LE,channels=1,rate=16000 ! lamemp3enc target=bitrate cbr=true bitrate=$(pipeline_parameters.bitrate,128)

mp3-24khz.specs: concat name=c ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! audio/x-raw,format=S16LE,channels=1,rate=24000 ! lamemp3enc target=bitrate cbr=true bitrate=$(pipeline_parameters.bitrate,128)

mp3-44khz.specs: concat name=c ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! audio/x-raw,format=S16LE,channels=1,rate=44100 ! lamemp3enc target=bitrate cbr=true bitrate=$(pipeline_parameters.bitrate,128)

opus-ogg-16khz.specs: concat name=c ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! audio/x-raw,format=S16LE,channels=1,rate=16000 ! opusenc frame-size=20 bitrate=$(pipeline_parameters.bitrate,64000) ! oggmux

opus-ogg-24khz.specs: concat name=c ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! audio/x-raw,format=S16LE,channels=1,rate=24000 ! opusenc frame-size=20 bitrate=$(pipeline_parameters.bitrate,64000) ! oggmux

opus-ogg-48khz.specs: concat name=c ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! audio/x-raw,format=S16LE,channels=1,rate=48000 ! opusenc frame-size=20 bitrate=$(pipeline_parameters.bitrate,64000) ! oggmux

opus-webm-16khz.specs: concat name=c ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! audio/x-raw,format=S16LE,channels=1,rate=16000 ! opusenc frame-size=20 bitrate=$(pipeline_parameters.bitrate,64000) ! webmmux streamable=true

opus-webm-24khz.specs: concat name=c ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! audio/x-raw,format=S16LE,channels=1,rate=24000 ! opusenc frame-size=20 bitrate=$(pipeline_parameters.bitrate,64000) ! webmmux streamable=true

opus-webm-48khz.specs: concat name=c ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! audio/x-raw,format=S16LE,channels=1,rate=48000 ! opusenc frame-size=20 bitrate=$(pipeline_parameters.bitrate,64000) ! webmmux streamable=true
